checks: complete TCP request reaches the bounded executor before lease expiry and retains OPEN beyond expiry while both workers are occupied
successful SEQUENCE renews after the delay; queued READ returns original data; suspended file worker was not replaced
default lease is 60 seconds; configured five-second lease is advertised and SEQUENCE renews OPEN beyond its initial expiry
SEQUENCE and exact replay on either session renew the shared client lease and keep an idle sibling session and its OPEN usable
idle session and OPEN expire at the advertised lease; another client opens the file while the expired stateid remains invalid
reducing the lease preserves the old reclaim window across repeated restarts, then converges to the configured duration after grace
initial CB_SEQUENCE BADSESSION retries exact slot after session-installation race, without requiring forechannel SEQUENCE on a callback-only session
initial-callback classification is captured when sent, so a forechannel SEQUENCE overtaking its BADSESSION reply cannot create a false permanent fault
CB_SEQUENCE DELAY retains exact request/slot, retries after backoff on the live connection and leaves ordinary file operations usable
BADSESSION, BADSLOT, SEQ_MISORDERED and SEQ_FALSE_RETRY report BACKCHANNEL_FAULT without tearing down the shared TCP stream; a new session recovers
CONN_NOT_BOUND_TO_SESSION withdraws callback readiness; explicit rebind retries the same sequence without marking a permanent session fault
